description: Dispatch by isinstance() instead of exact type (trap #1, the subclass/name-spoofing hole), so a list/dict/str subclass reaches a builtin handler and its own __len__/__iter__ run during capture (campaign T8-1: the never-runs-user-code property).

target.replace: handler = next((h for k, h in _DISPATCH.items() if isinstance(x, k)), None)
